summary: Frontend-only regression for show.porto v-UMKM. Verified home layout (5 portfolio templates + UMKM teaser, no etalase in portfolio slider), audiences (Landing Page UMKM w/ 3 fabric images), live demo UMKM tab (Toko Kain Tenun Jaya + 4 fabric products with correct wa.me/6285591197624 hrefs), pricing (2 groups porto+umkm with Rp150rb/Rp500rb & Rp600rb/Rp1,5jt; manual-book only on source cards), lead form (opens window.open to https://wa.me/6285591197624?text=... encoded with name/contact/intent/message, toast shows, form resets, NO /api/leads XHR), footer (whatsapp 085591197624 -> wa.me/6285591197624, email mailto, no ©/hak cipta/'Dibuat dengan presisi', no lang-toggle inside footer), UMKM page (all 6 template cards & modals aurum/sanggar/kadr/tenun/etalase/bersih open, previews scroll without 'undefined'/broken images, aurum secondary cover CTA reads 'Lihat Project Nikahan'), lang toggle EN/ID works on both pages (badge 'SMALL BUSINESS LANDING PAGE'), mobile 390px has scrollWidth 390 on both pages, /api/health returns {status:ok}. All 6 UMKM detail modals render cleanly with fullscreen/close/order buttons.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile menu links inside data-testid=nav-mobile-menu do NOT expose per-link data-testid attributes (only nav-mobile-cta present). Cannot select nav-link-umkm-template inside mobile menu.

Testid template generates double-dash for links with path="/". `path="/".replace("/", "")` -> "" then appends "-" -> testid `nav-link--template` and `nav-link--faq` on UMKM page. Expected `nav-link-template` (Portfolio→/) but that testid actually resolves to the self anchor Landing UMKM link because there are two links with id=template. Ambiguous / not spec-compliant.

action_items: Add data-testid to <a> elements inside nav-mobile-menu (mirror desktop testids) so mobile users' Landing UMKM link can be tested / analytics-tracked.

Fix Nav.js testid generator: sanitize path so path='/' produces empty prefix (e.g. use l.path && l.path!=='/' ? l.path.replace(/\//g,'')+'-' : ''). This also removes the ambiguity where two links with the same id collide on `nav-link-template`.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav.js:56 testid formula is fragile — collides when two links share the same section id (e.g. two `template` links on UMKM page) and produces double-dash IDs for root-path links.
Mobile menu items miss data-testid — reduces testability parity between desktop and mobile.

LeadSection window.open uses noopener,noreferrer which is fine; buildWaUrl correctly emits https://wa.me/6285591197624?text=... with 👋 emoji preserved (verified via monkey-patched window.open). Note: WhatsApp's own redirect to api.whatsapp.com may re-encode the emoji to U+FFFD — not a bug in our code.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend is fully static; do NOT expect /api/leads. Use window.open monkey-patch trick to verify wa.me URL (WhatsApp server rewrites to api.whatsapp.com after redirect). Lenis smooth-scroll requires ~1200ms wait after scroll_into_view. Modal preview scroll container = [data-testid=template-preview]. Two data-testid quirks to be aware of: `nav-link--template`/`nav-link--faq` (double dash) exist on UMKM page, and mobile menu <a> links currently lack testids.
